title: Hawaii ABLE savings program; establishment.
bodyText: The director of finance shall establish the Hawaii ABLE savings program to provide for individual savings accounts that empower individuals with a disability and their families to save private funds to support the individual with a disability.
bodyHtml: [§256B-2]  Hawaii ABLE savings program; establishment.  The director of finance shall establish the Hawaii ABLE savings program to provide for individual savings accounts that empower individuals with a disability and their families to save private funds to support the individual with a disability. [L 2015, c 206, pt of §2]
